title: AI and Blackness: Towards moving beyond bias and representation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic relatedness scores in the ConceptNet semantic knowledge network by comparing racialized terms (e.g., black_man, white_man) with concepts representing humanity versus sub-human/animalistic traits.

Analyzing network edge counts and semantic relatedness scores for intersectional terms (e.g., black_woman versus white_woman) within ConceptNet to demonstrate semantic erasure and compounded racialized and gendered misrepresentation.
